collection.title: Skoda Fabia Hatchback 2015 to 2021 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Skoda Fabia Hatchback 2015 - 2021 model requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 16" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Push Button arm attachment. We also have rear blade for this Fabia, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
